name: API Layer
description: HTTP request handling via go-chi and Huma — route registration, request/response binding, and the OpenAPI interface consumed by the frontend and CLI.

name: Authentication & Authorization
description: Office 365 OIDC login, API keys for automation, sessions, super-admin fallback, and the middleware enforcing group-based project access.

name: Service Layer
description: Business logic and orchestration including the git-like versioning subsystem (snapshots, patches, async version worker) that sits between handlers and stores.

name: Domain & Store Interfaces
description: Core domain models (elements, requirements, features, tasks, links, phases, versions) and the pluggable store/cache/file-storage interfaces every other layer depends on.

name: Persistence & Storage
description: Concrete implementations of the domain store interfaces — PostgreSQL stores, S3 file storage, and the Ristretto in-memory read cache.

name: Data Schema & Migrations
description: PostgreSQL schema migrations and the table/schema/endpoint definitions describing the persisted data model and the OpenAPI surface.

name: Infrastructure & CI/CD
description: Docker images, Docker Compose topology (backend, database, file storage), test container, and GitHub Actions packaging/test pipelines.

name: Configuration & Tooling
description: Application config loading, the config.yaml / go.mod project config, and build/dev tooling scripts (justfile, test results parser, entry points).

name: Documentation
description: Project documentation: README, ARCHITECTURE, DATA_MODEL, backend DIAGRAM, and Claude guidance.
